authorityRule: Audit findings are planning/conservation requirements. Current source, machine state, active work-slice/closure ledgers and executable evidence determine present implementation status. No audit GAP becomes fixed by prose alone and no CURRENT claim survives contradictory executable evidence.
target: Evidence-backed 5/5 maturity in every audit domain without capability loss, parallel intelligence truth, premature commercialization or premature learned production behavior.

executiveFindings.title: Canonical shared-intelligence boundary is wrong
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Engine/RuntimeSnapshot ceases to be the de-facto canonical domain boundary. Introduce versioned SymbolIntelligenceSnapshot, typed Evidence and material delta/event contracts with field-level provenance/freshness; retain compatibility adapters until consumers migrate.

executiveFindings.title: Opportunity Radar must seed a shared Opportunity Lifecycle
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Preserve Radar detector/evidence logic but remove independent lifecycle authority. Rapid Move, Radar and Discovery feed one Opportunity aggregate/state machine consumed by projections.

executiveFindings.title: Watchlist is membership only, not first-class intelligence
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Dedicated Watchlist becomes the user-selected-universe projection of shared Symbol Intelligence and Opportunity Lifecycle with ranked attention, durable promotion/demotion transitions, explanations, contradictions, freshness/trust, Research-as-of handoff, alerts and sync. No Watchlist scorer or acquisition loop.

executiveFindings.title: Adaptive intelligence is durable but not learned production behavior
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Build point-in-time outcomes, explicit censoring, calibration/drift/model registry, shadow/champion-challenger evaluation, sample floors, human approval, bounded reversible rollout and deterministic fallback before learned production influence.

executiveFindings.title: Renderer owns authoritative domain logic
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Characterize current computePlan/technical/family/geometry behavior with golden vectors, move authoritative deterministic calculations into versioned Go domain packages, dual/shadow compare, migrate clients and retire client authority only after parity/evidence.

executiveFindings.title: Hosted trust is advanced but not production-ready
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Finish development-grade hosted privacy/trust, real tenant isolation, normalized Postgres, managed secrets, service trust/IaC, backup/PITR/recovery, durable audit, observability and operator evidence without equating local/source tests with infrastructure proof.

executiveFindings.title: Desktop assurance is stronger than desktop distribution
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Provide macOS Developer ID/hardened-runtime/notarization/stapling and Windows trusted signing plus installer/update-channel/rollback strategy, secure storage, deep-link/auth handling and staged beta/stable delivery evidence.

executiveFindings.title: Commercial data rights are a P0 gate for public/commercial use
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Maintain executable capability-specific rights controls/provenance for display, cache, persistence, derived data, AI, multi-user and redistribution; obtain signed provider/legal evidence before relevant public/commercial activation. Credentials or successful calls never imply rights. Development lifecycle remains independent from commercial activation where approval is genuinely commercial-only.

executiveFindings.title: Documentation/current-state system is overgrown and drift-prone
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: One canonical roadmap/architecture/build/release truth, machine-state precedence, generated CURRENT/handoff status, historical evidence immutable, duplicate base/CURRENT narrative files merged or demoted and no hand-edited narrative independently declaring current status.

executiveFindings.title: Modular monolith is the correct next architecture
executiveFindings.requiredOutcome: Preserve Go and incrementally introduce domain/application/provider/persistence/platform package boundaries, Postgres + transactional outbox, stateless API/worker scale and thin typed clients. No Kubernetes/Kafka/microservice program without measured need.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Instrument identity outlives ticker
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Stable instrument/listing identity with validity ranges for symbol reuse, mergers, class changes, delistings and ADR conversion.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Point-in-time fundamentals and revised macro data
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Bitemporal/vintage-aware facts and strict as-of joins; historical evaluation must not see later revisions.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Exchange calendar, DST and half-day truth
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Versioned exchange-calendar/session service used by freshness, events, outcome windows and scheduling.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Clock skew and late/out-of-order events
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Material facts carry source/observed/ingested/effective/as-of/revision semantics and processing tolerates late ordering.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Raw versus adjusted price semantics
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Explicit series basis/action/revision lineage at every feature/outcome boundary.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Options open-interest is as-of, not intraday truth
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Expose OI as-of date, coverage/Greeks quality and never infer signed dealer positioning from gamma-by-OI proxy alone.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Alert fatigue and causal incident chains
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Rapid Move+catalyst+breakout can correlate into one explained incident with dedupe, acknowledgement, quiet-hours and delivery audit.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Provider correlation/shared upstream failure
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Provider agreement/redundancy carries upstream-independence metadata; correlated vendors do not overstate corroboration or resilience.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Provider/data revision policy
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Corrections create revision/supersedes lineage; prior decision truth remains reconstructable.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Privacy deletion versus immutable audit
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Explicit pseudonymization/retention policy reconciles deletion rights with security/financial audit retention and backup recovery.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Cross-device edit conflicts
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Revision/outbox/tombstone/conflict semantics for Watchlist/order/annotations/preferences and deterministic merge behavior.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Offline semantics
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Desktop encrypted cache is last-known/read-only/degraded and never presents stale evidence as live confidence.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: AI egress residency and provider terms
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: AI evidence egress has rights/privacy/residency policy independent from market-data display rights.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Prompt injection through untrusted evidence
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Source isolation, adversarial evals, bounded schemas and evidence-ID grounding across news/filing/community inputs.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Old-client/API schema evolution
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Version compatibility, deprecation, minimum-client and forced-upgrade rules for Web/macOS/Windows event/API contracts.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Personalization can corrupt calibration
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: User thresholds/views never mutate shared model truth; personalized projection remains separable/reproducible.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Adaptive selection bias
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Collect unbiased/control outcomes beyond only promoted/hydrated symbols and measure policy-induced sampling bias.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Censored outcomes
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Halts, missing bars, delistings, overnight gaps and insufficient horizon receive explicit outcome/censoring states.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Full snapshot fanout cost/exposure
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: User-scoped deltas/material references replace high-churn full snapshot distribution with compatibility migration.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Operational ownership and market-open support
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Named on-call/escalation/provider incident/runbook/SLO/error-budget ownership before service commitments.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Long King / Short King terminology is undefined
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Approve evidence-based domain definitions, horizon/side relationship, inputs, quality/freshness and outcome semantics before exposing as product labels or Watchlist columns; do not infer meaning from name alone.

mandatoryAuditWideRisks.title: Call Wall / Put Wall are planned, not current semantics
mandatoryAuditWideRisks.requiredOutcome: Define expiry-aware quality-gated options-wall semantics, OI as-of caveats, clustering/coverage rules and rights before product use; no dealer-positioning claim.

surfaceDisposition.target: Only session/regime, data trust, material transitions, scheduled risks and required action; deep-link details.
Shared market/regime/liquidity context travels with symbol decisions and contradictions.
Preserve horizon UX while server owns versioned two-sided deterministic policy/geometry.
Broad-universe projection of shared Opportunity Lifecycle.
Detector/evidence producer, not independent user-level scorer/lifecycle.
User-selected-universe projection of same lifecycle; no duplicate acquisition/scoring.
Frozen-as-of authoritative Decision Brief for every promotion/transition.
Evidence-bounded synthesis service; common actions may live in Research/global command; never parallel truth.
Operator machinery and provider secrets/routing controls hidden from ordinary users.
Preserve data/intelligence services; symbol-specific detail belongs in Research, optional event explorer only if justified.

temporalContract.rule: Retrieval/cache time is not evidence time. Unknown source/observation time remains unknown. Historical reconstruction must use as-of truth and revisions.

adaptiveControl.rule: Rules calculate facts/safety/lifecycle; statistical models estimate registered relationships but require evaluation/approval; LLMs explain structured evidence and cannot calculate canonical market facts, weights, routing, rights or lifecycle transitions.
evaluation: decision quality separate from explanation grounding

compatibilityRule: CHARACTERIZE -> ADD_NEW_OWNER -> DUAL_WRITE_OR_DUAL_READ_OR_SHADOW -> COMPARE -> MIGRATE_CONSUMERS -> PROVE_EQUIVALENCE_OR_IMPROVEMENT -> REMOVE_OLD_AUTHORITY -> KEEP_REGRESSION
zeroMissRule: All executive findings, audit-wide risks, surface dispositions, temporal/adaptive/scale rules and architecture decisions remain OPEN/PARTIAL until explicitly assigned and evidenced. G10 cannot close with an unexplained applicable audit row.
